name: organizational_forms
title: Cooperative organizational forms — feature coding
description: PROVISIONAL / PARTLY ASSISTANT-CODED seed dataset. A morphological (Zwicky) coding of cooperative and risk-pooling organizational forms (waqf, ie, compagnia, joint-stock corporation, nación, natie, kabu-nakama, and forms to be added) against a granular set of structural characteristics. Stored long/tidy: one row per form × characteristic. Supports the comparative typology in Clearing and Settling the Realm / HistorEE. Codes for forms and characteristics live in vocabularies/organizational_form_type.csv and vocabularies/organizational_form_characteristic.csv. Rows with coder 'ai' are provisional seed codings pending human verification; source_ref '[verify]' marks a coded value whose citation is not yet pinned.

fields.name: record_id
fields.title: Record ID
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for the coding. Never reused.

fields.name: type_id
fields.title: Organizational form (coded)
fields.description: Coded organizational form. Controlled vocabulary: vocabularies/organizational_form_type.csv. Not enum-constrained here because the form census is still growing (CONTRIBUTING §5); enforcement can be added once it stabilises.

fields.name: char_id
fields.title: Characteristic (coded)
fields.description: Coded structural characteristic. Controlled vocabulary: vocabularies/organizational_form_characteristic.csv, which also gives each characteristic's value type and allowed values.

fields.name: value
fields.title: Coded state
fields.description: The characteristic's state for this form. Ternary characteristics: 1 present, P partial, 0 absent. Nominal/ordinal characteristics: one of that characteristic's allowed categories (see vocabulary). Absence (0) is a datum, kept distinct from .NA (characteristic does not apply to this form) and .NR (not yet coded). Because admissible values are per-characteristic, this field is not enum-constrained.

fields.name: confidence
fields.title: Record confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the coding. Orthogonal to value: a contested coding is low even where value is 1 (present). Uncertainty is an explicit column, not prose.

fields.name: articulation
fields.title: Articulation
fields.description: Whether the coded function was articulated by the tradition's own advocates in their own idiom ('articulated'), or is visible only under the analyst's description ('analyst-imposed'). '.NR' where not yet assessed; propagates '.NA' with the value. Implements the methodology's constraint that functional coding be bounded by the sources' vocabulary, so that the two kinds of claim are never aggregated.

fields.name: source_ref
fields.title: Source reference
fields.description: Short citation supporting the coding, or '[verify]' where the value is asserted pending a pinned reference.

fields.name: source_lang
fields.title: Source language
fields.description: Language of source_ref. ISO 639-1 where a two-letter code exists, otherwise ISO 639-3. 'arc' is used broadly for Aramaic; the Babylonian Talmud is strictly Jewish Babylonian Aramaic (ISO 639-3 'tmr'), and a row citing it carries 'arc' with the distinction noted rather than a separate code.

fields.name: coder
fields.title: Coder
fields.description: Initials of the team member who entered the record. 'ai' marks a provisional assistant-generated seed coding pending human verification.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Free-text coder note: rationale, the school that dissents, caveats, cross-references.
